subject.title: 34 built-in skills missing trigger phrases in description field

question: Should bundled skill routing hints be added as concise WHEN wording in existing descriptions now, or should trigger-like routing move to a structured skill metadata contract instead?
rationale: Current source still uses descriptions as the prompt selection signal, but current docs also prioritize short descriptions and an open issue proposes a dedicated triggers field, so automation should not choose the public skill-authoring policy.

options.title: Approve concise description cleanup
options.body: Allow one focused metadata-only update that adds short WHEN wording only where it improves bundled-skill routing without bloating descriptions.

options.title: Defer to structured triggers
options.body: Keep descriptions compact and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76782 the canonical owner for exact keyword semantics.

options.title: Decline trigger expansion
options.body: Document that concise WHAT-only descriptions are intentional and close related wording-only cleanup attempts as not planned.

recommendation.title: Approve concise description cleanup
recommendation.body: Allow one focused metadata-only update that adds short WHEN wording only where it improves bundled-skill routing without bloating descriptions.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest current history across the skill prompt formatter, loader contract, docs constraints, and memory-wiki skill descriptions.
